summary_en: Hirakawa Hewtech will acquire full ownership of subsidiary Yoshinogawa Denshi through simplified share exchange, issuing 244,186 shares at an exchange ratio of 428.397 shares per Yoshinogawa share. The exchange is scheduled to take effect on December 21, 2026. The acquisition aims to strengthen the FA and robotics cable business through integration of design, manufacturing technology, and sales capabilities.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Subsidiary Status of Consolidated Subsidiary through Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. (5821) will acquire full ownership of its consolidated subsidiary Yoshinogawa Denshi Co., Ltd. through a simplified share exchange. The parent company will issue 244,186 ordinary shares as consideration, at an exchange ratio of 428.397 Hirakawa shares for each Yoshinogawa share. The exchange is scheduled to become effective on December 21, 2026. Since this is a simplified exchange under Article 796(2) of the Companies Act, Hirakawa will not require shareholder approval; Yoshinogawa will hold a shareholder meeting on November 20, 2026.

Yoshinogawa Denshi specializes in robot cables with superior durability and flexibility for industrial robots, supported by long-established brand recognition and design and manufacturing expertise. Hirakawa possesses strengths in various FA cables and high-speed, high-capacity data transmission cables for servers, storage systems, and automotive and industrial cameras. By integrating the two companies' management resources and technical capabilities, the group aims to accelerate decision-making, strengthen coordination in technology development and sales activities, and improve operational efficiency.

The transaction is expected to support revenue expansion and new product development in the factory automation market—including the globally growing industrial robotics sector—and in next-generation IoT markets covering mobility and medical devices, thereby enhancing enterprise value of the Hirakawa group.
